coding.note: The page text mixes two columns line by line, so several quotes are exact copies of these mixed lines. Main table comparators are BART and Flan-T5. BART and SOTA scores are cited from earlier papers (superscripts), while Flan-T5 appears to have been run by the authors, so rerun and copied scores are both MIXED. The supervised-vs-unsupervised claim is PARTIAL because MVP is initialised from BART and trained further, which confounds the comparison. Multi-task vs single-task and the prompt variants (S/R/M) are compared at matched settings. GLUE test scores come from the official server, but I did not count that as third-party evaluation. The paper gives 25GB, 32M examples and about 20k steps but no token count. It names 32 V100 GPUs but gives no training duration, so compute is N.
